context: constraint: constitution 2.0.0 principles I-III, V; Apache-2.0-compatible deps
intent: Shared diagram designer framework so new ADP designers are declared, not coded

decisions.decision: Three proving designers: test-only sample, FreeMind migrated, new draw.io module
decisions.why: User clarified FR-031; draw.io is positioned XML with CC-BY-4.0 published templates
decisions.rejected: GraphML/yEd (unclear example licences), DOT, PlantUML/Mermaid (no positions)

decisions.decision: Own Swing/Java2D canvas, no third-party runtime library
decisions.why: Survey: every complete library owns model/undo/serialisation or needs JCEF
decisions.rejected: JGraphX (archived, own undo), maxGraph/draw.io via JCEF

decisions.decision: Framework as packages in core; XmlScanner moved to core/xml with XmlTree and XmlEdits
decisions.why: Principle III; two XML formats need attribute offsets
decisions.rejected: Separate diagram module; copying the scanner into drawio

decisions.decision: Designers declared with Java builders validated in build(), DefinitionException lists every problem
decisions.why: Rules and mappings are code anyway; no second language
decisions.rejected: XML/JSON declaration files, annotations, custom extension point

decisions.decision: Mapping reads an immutable Diagram and returns range-exact TextChanges per change kind; framework owns command, re-read, diff
decisions.why: Proven FreeMind pattern for byte-identical round trips and one undo step
decisions.rejected: Mutable model serialised back by the framework

decisions.decision: FR-030 read as: no file rewrite and no disk re-read; in-memory re-read per edit, held to SC-005 by performance tests
decisions.why: Incremental parsing per format has no requirement behind it

decisions.decision: Change notifications from diffing successive Diagram snapshots
decisions.why: One path covers edits, undo, redo and external text changes

decisions.decision: Optional DiagramLayout for laid-out designers; moves become drops
decisions.why: FreeMind positions come from its tree layout, not the file

decisions.decision: Toolbox and ADP Properties as ToolWindowFactory tool windows; panel on JBTable with platform editors
decisions.why: Principle I; platform PropertyTable is internal
decisions.rejected: In-editor palette; Kotlin UI DSL forms

decisions.decision: Orthogonal router: direct, one-bend, Z candidates, then sparse-grid A*, cached per connection
decisions.why: Keeps 1,500 connections within SC-005; FR-015 is SHOULD

decisions.decision: SC-001 and SC-006 enforced by CodeSizeTest (342-line budget vs 3,423 FreeMind baseline) and a verifyDependencyLicences Gradle task
Stories plug canvas tools and layers in through a DiagramFeature extension point, one descriptor fragment per story
decisions.why: Keeps every file owned by one phase, as spec 002 did with its fragments
decisions.rejected: One canvas class edited by all four stories

decisions.decision: Keep NodeView, AdpDesignerEditor and DesignerDriver unchanged; add DiagramDriver
decisions.why: FreeMind tests stay byte-for-byte unchanged as the migration safety net
decisions.rejected: Replacing NodeView with ElementView across the test kit

decisions.decision: Drop scroll persistence and the public DesignerAction extraction
decisions.rejected: Carrying them from the first plan draft

plan.summary: Plan for a declared diagram framework in core, proven by a sample designer, a migrated FreeMind designer and a new draw.io designer
plan.key_finding: No usable library leaves the model and undo to the platform, so the canvas is built on Java2D; draw.io templates are CC-BY-4.0 but compressed and must be decompressed once for vendoring

tasks.summary: 117 tasks in 9 phases: setup, foundational, US1-US4, FreeMind migration, draw.io designer, polish; each phase owns disjoint files via DiagramFeature fragments

approach: Designers declare element, connection, sector and property types with Java builders and supply a mapping that reads the file into an immutable diagram and turns each change into range-exact text changes. A shared Java2D canvas, toolbox and property tool windows in core turn every gesture into one platform undoable command. A sample designer, the migrated FreeMind designer and a new draw.io designer prove it.

concerns.note: FR-030 read as no rewrite and no disk re-read; each edit re-reads the in-memory document. Ceiling: SC-005 100 ms edit budget. If performance tests bind, add incremental re-read per format or tighten spec wording via clarify.
SC-001 342-line budget is tight for draw.io; if missed, move generic XML help into core, never exempt.
